subject: Future Tech
title: AVs and Urban Redesign
description: A 60-second lesson on AVs and Urban Redesign.

buildup.text: AVs don't need wide lanes, traffic signals, or parking structures.

discovery.text: Shared AV fleets could reduce the number of cars in a city by 80%. Fewer cars means less congestion and cleaner air.

twist.text: But AVs could also increase sprawl.

climax.text: Urban planning must anticipate both outcomes.

punchline.text: Same technology, two futures. Policy decides which one.

quiz.question: How could shared AVs change city parking?
options: Parking lots would need to be larger
Up to 30% of city land could be repurposed
